recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source change is needed for the Extension binding question; any future editorial alignment around Duration belongs to the later FHIR-30085 or a future issue, not this STU3 Extension removal.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core issue reported that ElementDefinition.binding described bindings for coded elements and string/uri while invariant eld-11 also allowed Extension, and the approved resolution was to remove Extension from eld-11.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite svn revision 13330 and say the change was already done. The matching git-svn commit 7508d2f2cbc6e6e4b77037539465e714c045a3d0, build@13330, removed Extension from both the FHIRPath and XPath forms of eld-11 in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini, and the elementdefinition type page mapping confirms the inspected spreadsheet source is in current build scope. Later FHIR-30085 added Duration to the same invariant and is already represented on the combined branch; that later change does not reintroduce Extension. Direct Confluence and Zulip searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the latest combined source already satisfies the FHIR-13553 resolution: eld-11 permits the coded/string/uri/Duration set and external type codes, but not Extension, and the ElementDefinition.binding definition does not mention Extension.
